prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” personal-injury lawyer for every car wreck — the right lawyer depends on the specifics of your crash and what you value (trial experience, negotiation skill, local reputation, language, availability, etc.). I can help you find the best match. First, here are practical steps and criteria to use when choosing a Houston car-accident lawyer, plus how I can help next.

How to choose the best lawyer for your case
- Relevant experience: look for attorneys who handle car-accident cases regularly and who have experience with cases like yours (serious injuries, wrongful death, disputed fault).
- Trial and negotiation track record: many cases settle, but you want someone who will and can take the case to trial successfully if needed.
- Results and references: ask about past settlements/verdicts for similar injuries; check client reviews.
- Communication and responsiveness: you want regular updates and a lawyer who answers questions promptly.
- Resources and experts: serious cases need medical experts, accident reconstruction, etc. Make sure the firm can fund and manage those costs.
- Fees and costs: most PI lawyers work on contingency. Confirm the percentage, whether it changes if suit is filed, and what expenses are deducted.
- Local knowledge: Houston-area courts, judges, and insurance companies — local experience matters.
- Professional standing: check disciplinary history with the State Bar of Texas.

Where to search and verify
- Texas State Bar (member lookup) for license/discipline
- Houston Bar Association lawyer referral
- Super Lawyers, Martindale-Hubbell, Avvo — for peer and client reviews
- Google and Yelp reviews, plus firm case results posted on firm websites

Questions to ask in a free consultation
- How long have you handled car-accident cases in Houston?
- What percentage of your cases settle vs go to trial?
- What are some recent results for cases like mine?
- Who will handle my case day-to-day (attorney or paralegal)?
- What is your contingency fee? How are costs handled?
- How will you communicate case updates and how often?
- Do you handle medical liens and bills during the case?
- What is your assessment of liability and potential value in my case?

Immediate steps to protect your claim
- Get medical care and follow doctors’ orders.
- Preserve evidence: photos, police report number, witness contact info.
- Don’t give recorded statements or sign releases for the insurance company without consulting a lawyer.
- Note deadlines: Texas generally has a 2‑year statute of limitations for personal injury claims (don’t wait).

If you want, I can:
- Find top-rated car-accident lawyers or firms in Houston for your specific needs (please tell me your zip code, the date of the crash, brief injury description, and whether there’s a dispute about fault).
- Draft a short message or list of questions you can use in consultations.
Tell me what you prefer (trial-focused, bilingual, low-fee, aggressive negotiator, local small firm vs large national), and I’ll pull tailored recommendations.
